title: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: For this part , you are allowed 30 minutes to write on the topic Changes in the Way of Communication. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: The way people communicate has changed dramatically over the past few decades. In the past, staying in touch meant writing letters or making phone calls, while nowadays a tap on the screen connects us instantly. In my view, this shift has reshaped our lives in profound ways. The most obvious change lies in speed and distance. Our parents used to wait days for a letter to arrive, whereas we now send messages, photos and even video calls across continents in seconds. Take my grandmother as an example: she once relied on the post office, but today she chats with me through instant messaging and social media every night. Such tools help families stay connected regardless of where they live. However, this convenience comes at a price. When face-to-face talk is replaced by screens, warmth and sincerity may fade away. Therefore, we should embrace new means of communication while still valuing genuine human contact. Only by balancing the two can we truly benefit from these changes.
keyPoints: 三句成型：现象＋对比＋立场。首段严格照 paragraphGuide 的三步落地：开头 The way people communicate has changed dramatically 是现象句；In the past, ... while nowadays ... 是今 昔对比句，直接扣住题眼；In my view, this shift has reshaped our lives 是立场句，为全文定调。

主题句＋对比＋举例＋小结齐活。主体段落实四步：The most obvious change lies in speed and distance 是主题句；used to wait days ... whereas we now send ... 是新旧对比；Take my grandmother as an example 引出祖母的具体例子；末句 help families stay connected 小 结回扣中心，用上了 instant messaging、social media、stay connected 等主题表达，避免反复 用 communicate。

让步转折收出辩证立场。尾段用 However, this convenience comes at a price 让步、承认 代价，再用 Therefore, we should embrace ... while still valuing ... 提出平衡主张，末句 Only by balancing the two can we truly benefit 收口，既不一边倒也不超界，稳稳收束。
